excerpt: Attention Is Half of What You Need. Dense transformer attention excels at soft semantic parsing, yet treating ephemeral softmax context as a permanent memory warehouse, truth-value referee, and moral conscience yields million-token bills, polite RLHF sycophancy, cross-session amnesia, and agents that grade their own homework with 99.89% self-certified verifier theater. This repository pairs a stateless language model with a local ACID SQLite ledger (schema/schema.sql) enforcing engine-level verifier-scope coupling (trg_verif_scope_coupling), single-claim atomicity, and defeasible negative provenance ([FALSIFIED] → reopens). Attention gives you the voice; the ledger keeps the receipts. Provenance: Compiled as an open synthesis of prior public work (official deposit metadata in CITATION.cff and .zenodo.json) Zenodo DOI (Reserve Before Publish): 10.5281/zenodo. 24431728 Licenses: MIT (code in schema/, scraper/, scripts/) · CC BY 4.0 (white papers, historiography, and reports in Sage/, chapters/) The core relational ledger, trg_verif_scope_coupling anti-theater trigger, defeasible appeal state machine, and deterministic Kestrel-7 oracle self-test run locally on Python 3 + SQLite 3 (FTS5). Hybrid TF-IDF RRF retrieval tests (test_pilot_harness.py) require only numpy and scikit-learn (pip install -r requirements.txt). # 1. Verify all 11 end-to-end schema, trigger, appeal, MCP, CLI, and DOM non-regression invariants python3 -m unittest scripts/test_pilot_harness.py -v # 2. Verify the 20-step Kestrel-7 deterministic tolerance gauntlet & SQLite state oracle python3 scripts/benchmark_gauntlet.py --self-test # 3. Verify cryptographic integrity of the published Volume I, Volume II & Failures/Parables PDFs (cd Sage && shasum -a 256 -c two_hands_decentralized_whitepaper.pdf.sha256 && shasum -a 256 -c corpus_history_companion_volume.pdf.sha256 && shasum -a 256 -c corpus_failures_and_parables.pdf.sha256) To archive your own Gemini web conversations into a local ./data/archive.db…
